import math

class Ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
class Quantity(value := 1.0, dimension := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0])

int integer_text(string text)
    return int(text)

int integer_power(int base, int exponent)
    result := 1
    for: 0 <= index < exponent
        result *= base
    return result

int gcd_integer(int first, int second)
    first = math.abs(first)
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    return first

Ratio ratio_parts(real value)
    text := string(value)
    fields := text.split("/")
    if #fields == 2
        return Ratio(integer_text(fields[0]), integer_text(fields[1]))
    fields = text.split(".")
    if #fields == 1
        return Ratio(integer_text(text), 1)
    denominator := integer_power(10, int(#fields[1]))
    numerator := integer_text(fields[0]) * denominator + (if text.starts_with("-") then -1 else 1) * integer_text(fields[1])
    divisor := gcd_integer(numerator, denominator)
    return Ratio(numerator / divisor, denominator / divisor)

string fraction_text(real value)
    parts := ratio_parts(value)
    return if parts.denominator == 1 then string(parts.numerator) else "{parts.numerator}/{parts.denominator}"

string decimal_text(real value)
    parts := ratio_parts(value)
    magnitude := math.abs(parts.numerator)
    whole := magnitude / parts.denominator
    tail := (magnitude % parts.denominator) * 1000000 / parts.denominator
    digits := string(tail)
    sign := if parts.numerator < 0 then "-" else ""
    return "{sign}{whole}." + "0" * nat(6 - int(#digits)) + digits

string notation(real value, string unit)
    return fraction_text(value) + " " + unit + " (" + decimal_text(value) + ")"

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool includes<T>(const T[] values, T sought)
    for item := values[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

bool letter(string character)
    return #character == 1 and "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(character)

bool digit(string character)
    return #character == 1 and "0123456789".contains(character)

bool digits_only(string text)
    if text == ""
        return false
    for: index < #text
        if not digit(text[index])
            return false
    return true

real | error parse_number(string text)
    negative := text.starts_with("-")
    body := if negative then text[1:] else text
    real value
    if digits_only(body)
        value = real(integer_text(body))
    elif body.contains(".")
        pieces := body.split(".")
        if #pieces != 2 or not digits_only(pieces[0]) or not digits_only(pieces[1])
            return error("BAD NUMBER " + text)
        denominator := integer_power(10, int(#pieces[1]))
        value = real(integer_text(pieces[0]) * denominator + integer_text(pieces[1])) / real(denominator)
    elif body.contains("/")
        pieces := body.split("/")
        if #pieces != 2 or not digits_only(pieces[0]) or not digits_only(pieces[1])
            return error("BAD NUMBER " + text)
        denominator := integer_text(pieces[1])
        if denominator == 0
            return error("BAD NUMBER " + text)
        value = real(integer_text(pieces[0])) / real(denominator)
    else
        return error("BAD NUMBER " + text)
    return if negative then -value else value

int | error checked_exponent(string text)
    value := integer_text(text)
    if value == 0 or value < -3 or value > 3
        return error("BAD EXPONENT " + text)
    return value

real scalar_power(real value, int exponent)
    if exponent < 0
        value = 1.0 / value
    result := 1.0
    for: 0 <= index < math.abs(exponent)
        result *= value
    return result

void | error check_name(string name, bool variable)
    if #name == 0 or #name > 12
        return error("BAD NAME " + name)
    for: index < #name
        if not letter(name[index])
            return error("BAD NAME " + name)
    if variable and includes(["abs", "sqrt", "min", "max"], name)
        return error("BAD NAME " + name)
    return void

string dimension_text(const int[] dimension)
    names := ["kg", "m", "s", "A", "K", "mol", "cd"]
    string[] parts := []
    for index := dimension.indices()[]
        if dimension[index] != 0
            part := names[index]
            if dimension[index] != 1
                part += "^{dimension[index]}"
            parts = parts.append(part)
    return if #parts == 0 then "1" else parts.join(" ")

void | error match_dimensions(const int[] left, const int[] right)
    if left != right
        return error("DIMENSION MISMATCH " + dimension_text(left) + " vs " + dimension_text(right))
    return void

bool dimensionless(const int[] dimension)
    return dimension == [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]

class Kind(string name, int[] dimension)
class Definition(real value, string expression)
class Unit(string symbol, Quantity quantity, bool prefixable, Definition | none definition := none)
class Database(Unit[] units, Kind[] kinds)
    variables := map<string, Quantity>()

int[] | none kind_dimension(const Database database, string name)
    for item := database.kinds[]
        if item.name == name
            return item.dimension
    return none

string kind_name(const Database database, const int[] dimension)
    for item := database.kinds[]
        if item.dimension == dimension
            return item.name
    return "-"

class Builtin(string symbol, int numerator, int denominator, string kind, bool prefixable)

Database new_database()
    kinds := [
        Kind("dimensionless", [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]), Kind("length", [0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]),
        Kind("mass", [1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]), Kind("time", [0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0]),
        Kind("current", [0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0]), Kind("temperature", [0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0]),
        Kind("amount", [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0]), Kind("luminous_intensity", [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1]),
        Kind("area", [0, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]), Kind("volume", [0, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]),
        Kind("speed", [0, 1, -1, 0, 0, 0, 0]), Kind("acceleration", [0, 1, -2, 0, 0, 0, 0]),
        Kind("density", [1, -3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]), Kind("momentum", [1, 1, -1, 0, 0, 0, 0]),
        Kind("force", [1, 1, -2, 0, 0, 0, 0]), Kind("energy", [1, 2, -2, 0, 0, 0, 0]),
        Kind("power", [1, 2, -3, 0, 0, 0, 0]), Kind("pressure", [1, -1, -2, 0, 0, 0, 0]),
        Kind("frequency", [0, 0, -1, 0, 0, 0, 0]), Kind("charge", [0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0]),
        Kind("voltage", [1, 2, -3, -1, 0, 0, 0]), Kind("resistance", [1, 2, -3, -2, 0, 0, 0]),
        Kind("conductance", [-1, -2, 3, 2, 0, 0, 0]), Kind("capacitance", [-1, -2, 4, 2, 0, 0, 0]),
        Kind("magnetic_flux", [1, 2, -2, -1, 0, 0, 0]), Kind("flux_density", [1, 0, -2, -1, 0, 0, 0]),
        Kind("inductance", [1, 2, -2, -2, 0, 0, 0]), Kind("illuminance", [0, -2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1]),
        Kind("catalytic_activity", [0, 0, -1, 0, 0, 1, 0]),
    ]
    builtins := [
        Builtin("m", 1, 1, "length", true), Builtin("g", 1, 1000, "mass", true),
        Builtin("s", 1, 1, "time", true), Builtin("A", 1, 1, "current", true),
        Builtin("K", 1, 1, "temperature", true), Builtin("mol", 1, 1, "amount", true),
        Builtin("cd", 1, 1, "luminous_intensity", true), Builtin("N", 1, 1, "force", true),
        Builtin("J", 1, 1, "energy", true), Builtin("W", 1, 1, "power", true),
        Builtin("Pa", 1, 1, "pressure", true), Builtin("Hz", 1, 1, "frequency", true),
        Builtin("C", 1, 1, "charge", true), Builtin("V", 1, 1, "voltage", true),
        Builtin("ohm", 1, 1, "resistance", true), Builtin("S", 1, 1, "conductance", true),
        Builtin("F", 1, 1, "capacitance", true), Builtin("Wb", 1, 1, "magnetic_flux", true),
        Builtin("T", 1, 1, "flux_density", true), Builtin("H", 1, 1, "inductance", true),
        Builtin("lx", 1, 1, "illuminance", true), Builtin("kat", 1, 1, "catalytic_activity", true),
        Builtin("L", 1, 1000, "volume", true), Builtin("t", 1000, 1, "mass", false),
        Builtin("min", 60, 1, "time", false), Builtin("h", 3600, 1, "time", false),
        Builtin("day", 86400, 1, "time", false), Builtin("in", 127, 5000, "length", false),
        Builtin("ft", 381, 1250, "length", false), Builtin("yd", 1143, 1250, "length", false),
        Builtin("mi", 201168, 125, "length", false), Builtin("nmi", 1852, 1, "length", false),
        Builtin("ha", 10000, 1, "area", false), Builtin("kn", 463, 900, "speed", false),
        Builtin("bar", 100000, 1, "pressure", true), Builtin("atm", 101325, 1, "pressure", false),
        Builtin("Torr", 20265, 152, "pressure", false), Builtin("cal", 523, 125, "energy", true),
        Builtin("Wh", 3600, 1, "energy", true), Builtin("Ah", 3600, 1, "charge", true),
        Builtin("dC", 1, 1, "temperature", false), Builtin("dF", 5, 9, "temperature", false),
    ]
    result := Database([], kinds)
    for row := builtins[]
        match kind_dimension(result, row.kind)
            int[] dimension
                result.units = result.units.append(Unit(row.symbol, Quantity(real(row.numerator) / real(row.denominator), dimension), row.prefixable))
            none
                continue
    return result

class Prefix(string symbol, real factor)

Quantity | none resolve(const Database database, string name)
    for item := database.units[]
        if item.symbol == name
            return item.quantity
    prefixes := [
        Prefix("G", 1000000000.0), Prefix("M", 1000000.0), Prefix("k", 1000.0),
        Prefix("h", 100.0), Prefix("da", 10.0), Prefix("d", 1.0 / 10.0),
        Prefix("c", 1.0 / 100.0), Prefix("m", 1.0 / 1000.0),
        Prefix("u", 1.0 / 1000000.0), Prefix("n", 1.0 / 1000000000.0),
    ]
    for prefix := prefixes[]
        if name.starts_with(prefix.symbol)
            rest := name[#prefix.symbol:]
            for item := database.units[0:<42][]
                if item.prefixable and item.symbol == rest
                    return Quantity(prefix.factor * item.quantity.value, item.quantity.dimension)
    return none

string simplified(const Database database, const int[] dimension)
    for item := database.units[]
        if item.quantity.value == 1.0 and item.quantity.dimension == dimension
            return item.symbol
    return dimension_text(dimension)

Unit[] selected_units(const Database database, const int[] dimension)
    remaining := [for item := database.units[] if item.quantity.dimension == dimension then item]
    Unit[] result := []
    while #remaining != 0
        smallest := [for item := remaining[] then item.quantity.value].min()
        symbols := [for item := remaining[] if item.quantity.value == smallest then item.symbol]
        for symbol := symbols.sorted()[]
            for item := remaining[]
                if item.symbol == symbol
                    result = result.append(item)
                    break
        remaining = [for item := remaining[] if item.quantity.value != smallest then item]
    return result

enum TokenKind
    Identifier
    Number
    Unit
    Punctuation
    Invalid
    End

enum Operation
    Number
    Name
    UnitValue
    Variable
    Call
    Negative
    Power
    Add
    Subtract
    Multiply
    Divide

class Token(TokenKind kind, string text, int position)
class Node(Operation kind, text := "", unit := "", left := -1, right := -1, int[] arguments := [], resolved := Quantity(), exponent := 0)
class Tree(Node[] nodes, int root)
class Parser(string source, Token[] tokens, position := 0, Node[] nodes := [])

Parser tokenize(string source, bool quantity)
    Token[] tokens := []
    index := 0
    count := int(#source)
    while index < count
        start := index
        character := source[index]
        index += 1
        TokenKind kind := TokenKind.Invalid
        if letter(character)
            kind = TokenKind.Identifier
            while index < count and letter(source[index])
                index += 1
        elif digit(character)
            kind = TokenKind.Number
            while index < count and digit(source[index])
                index += 1
            if quantity and index + 1 < count and source[index] == "." and digit(source[index + 1])
                index += 1
                while index < count and digit(source[index])
                    index += 1
        elif quantity and character == "["
            closing := index
            while closing < count and source[closing] != "]"
                closing += 1
            if index < closing < count
                kind = TokenKind.Unit
                index = closing + 1
        elif (if quantity then "+-*/^()," else "*/^()-").contains(character)
            kind = TokenKind.Punctuation
        tokens = tokens.append(Token(kind, source[start:<index], start + 1))
    return Parser(source, tokens.append(Token(TokenKind.End, "", count + 1)))

Token current(const Parser parser)
    return parser.tokens[parser.position]

string syntax_message(const Parser parser)
    token := current(parser)
    position := if token.kind == TokenKind.End then "END" else string(token.position)
    return "SYNTAX {parser.source} AT {position}"

bool accept(Parser &parser, string text)
    if current(parser).text != text
        return false
    parser.position += 1
    return true

void | error expect(Parser &parser, string text)
    if not accept(&parser, text)
        return error(syntax_message(parser))
    return void

int append_node(Parser &parser, Node item)
    index := int(#parser.nodes)
    parser.nodes = parser.nodes.append(item)
    return index

string | error parse_exponent(Parser &parser)
    sign := if accept(&parser, "-") then "-" else ""
    token := current(parser)
    if token.kind != TokenKind.Number or token.text.contains(".")
        return error(syntax_message(parser))
    parser.position += 1
    return sign + token.text

int | error unit_expression(Parser &parser);

int | error unit_term(Parser &parser)
    token := current(parser)
    int result
    if token.kind == TokenKind.Identifier
        parser.position += 1
        result = append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Name, text = token.text))
    elif token.kind == TokenKind.Number and token.text[0] != "0"
        parser.position += 1
        result = append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Number, text = token.text))
    elif accept(&parser, "(")
        result = try unit_expression(&parser)
        try expect(&parser, ")")
    else
        return error(syntax_message(parser))
    if accept(&parser, "^")
        exponent := try parse_exponent(&parser)
        result = append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Power, text = exponent, left = result))
    return result

int | error unit_expression(Parser &parser)
    identity := append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Number, text = "1"))
    first := try unit_term(&parser)
    result := append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Multiply, left = identity, right = first))
    while current(parser).text == "*" or current(parser).text == "/"
        Operation operation := if current(parser).text == "*" then Operation.Multiply else Operation.Divide
        parser.position += 1
        following := try unit_term(&parser)
        result = append_node(&parser, Node(operation, left = result, right = following))
    return result

void | error validate_unit(const Database database, Node[] &nodes, int index)
    item := nodes[index]
    if item.kind == Operation.Name
        match resolve(database, item.text)
            Quantity found
                nodes[index].resolved = found
            none
                return error("UNKNOWN UNIT " + item.text)
    elif item.kind == Operation.Power
        try validate_unit(database, &nodes, item.left)
        nodes[index].exponent = try checked_exponent(item.text)
    elif item.kind == Operation.Multiply or item.kind == Operation.Divide
        try validate_unit(database, &nodes, item.left)
        try validate_unit(database, &nodes, item.right)
    return void

Tree | error parse_unit(const Database database, string source)
    parser := tokenize(source, false)
    root := try unit_expression(&parser)
    if current(parser).kind != TokenKind.End
        return error(syntax_message(parser))
    try validate_unit(database, &parser.nodes, root)
    return Tree(parser.nodes, root)

Quantity evaluate_unit(const Node[] nodes, int index)
    item := nodes[index]
    if item.kind == Operation.Number
        return Quantity(real(integer_text(item.text)))
    if item.kind == Operation.Name
        return item.resolved
    left := evaluate_unit(nodes, item.left)
    if item.kind == Operation.Power
        return Quantity(scalar_power(left.value, item.exponent), left.dimension * item.exponent)
    right := evaluate_unit(nodes, item.right)
    if item.kind == Operation.Multiply
        return Quantity(left.value * right.value, left.dimension + right.dimension)
    return Quantity(left.value / right.value, left.dimension - right.dimension)

Quantity | error unit_quantity(const Database database, string source)
    tree := try parse_unit(database, source)
    return evaluate_unit(tree.nodes, tree.root)

class Reduced(coefficient := 1.0, string[] names := [], int[] powers := [])

Reduced reduce_node(const Node[] nodes, int index)
    item := nodes[index]
    if item.kind == Operation.Number
        return Reduced(real(integer_text(item.text)))
    if item.kind == Operation.Name
        return Reduced(1.0, [item.text], [1])
    left := reduce_node(nodes, item.left)
    if item.kind == Operation.Power
        return Reduced(scalar_power(left.coefficient, item.exponent), left.names, left.powers * item.exponent)
    right := reduce_node(nodes, item.right)
    multiply := item.kind == Operation.Multiply
    left.coefficient = if multiply then left.coefficient * right.coefficient else left.coefficient / right.coefficient
    sign := if multiply then 1 else -1
    for position := right.names.indices()[]
        found := -1
        for candidate := left.names.indices()[]
            if left.names[candidate] == right.names[position]
                found = int(candidate)
                break
        if found < 0
            left.names = left.names.append(right.names[position])
            left.powers = left.powers.append(sign * right.powers[position])
        else
            left.powers[found] += sign * right.powers[position]
    return left

string reduced_text(const Tree tree)
    value := reduce_node(tree.nodes, tree.root)
    string[] pieces := []
    if value.coefficient != 1.0
        pieces = pieces.append(fraction_text(value.coefficient))
    for index := value.names.indices()[]
        if value.powers[index] != 0
            text := value.names[index]
            if value.powers[index] != 1
                text += "^{value.powers[index]}"
            pieces = pieces.append(text)
    return if #pieces == 0 then "1" else pieces.join(" ")

int | error quantity_expression(Parser &parser);

int | error quantity_primary(Parser &parser)
    token := current(parser)
    int result
    if token.kind == TokenKind.Number
        parser.position += 1
        if current(parser).kind == TokenKind.Unit
            text := current(parser).text
            parser.position += 1
            result = append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.UnitValue, text = token.text, unit = text[1:<int(#text) - 1]))
        else
            result = append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Number, text = token.text))
    elif token.kind == TokenKind.Unit
        parser.position += 1
        result = append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.UnitValue, text = "1", unit = token.text[1:<int(#token.text) - 1]))
    elif token.kind == TokenKind.Identifier
        parser.position += 1
        if accept(&parser, "(")
            first := try quantity_expression(&parser)
            arguments := [first]
            while accept(&parser, ",")
                following := try quantity_expression(&parser)
                arguments = arguments.append(following)
            try expect(&parser, ")")
            result = append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Call, text = token.text, arguments = arguments))
        else
            result = append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Variable, text = token.text))
    elif accept(&parser, "(")
        result = try quantity_expression(&parser)
        try expect(&parser, ")")
    else
        return error(syntax_message(parser))
    if accept(&parser, "^")
        exponent := try parse_exponent(&parser)
        result = append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Power, text = exponent, left = result))
    return result

int | error quantity_unary(Parser &parser)
    if accept(&parser, "-")
        child := try quantity_unary(&parser)
        return append_node(&parser, Node(Operation.Negative, left = child))
    return quantity_primary(&parser)

int | error quantity_product(Parser &parser)
    result := try quantity_unary(&parser)
    while current(parser).text == "*" or current(parser).text == "/"
        Operation operation := if current(parser).text == "*" then Operation.Multiply else Operation.Divide
        parser.position += 1
        following := try quantity_unary(&parser)
        result = append_node(&parser, Node(operation, left = result, right = following))
    return result

int | error quantity_expression(Parser &parser)
    result := try quantity_product(&parser)
    while current(parser).text == "+" or current(parser).text == "-"
        Operation operation := if current(parser).text == "+" then Operation.Add else Operation.Subtract
        parser.position += 1
        following := try quantity_product(&parser)
        result = append_node(&parser, Node(operation, left = result, right = following))
    return result

int integer_sqrt(int value)
    if value < 2
        return value
    current_value := value
    following := (value + 1) / 2
    while following < current_value
        current_value = following
        following = (current_value + value / current_value) / 2
    return current_value

Quantity | error evaluate_quantity(const Database database, const Node[] nodes, int index)
    item := nodes[index]
    if item.kind == Operation.Number
        return Quantity(try parse_number(item.text))
    if item.kind == Operation.UnitValue
        unit := try unit_quantity(database, item.unit)
        value := try parse_number(item.text)
        return Quantity(value * unit.value, unit.dimension)
    if item.kind == Operation.Variable
        match database.variables.get(item.text)
            Quantity stored
                return stored
            none
                return error("UNKNOWN VARIABLE " + item.text)
    if item.kind == Operation.Call
        if not includes(["abs", "sqrt", "min", "max"], item.text)
            return error("UNKNOWN FUNCTION " + item.text)
        required := if item.text == "abs" or item.text == "sqrt" then 1 else 2
        if int(#item.arguments) != required
            return error("BAD ARGUMENTS " + item.text)
        first := try evaluate_quantity(database, nodes, item.arguments[0])
        if item.text == "abs"
            return Quantity(math.abs(first.value), first.dimension)
        if item.text == "sqrt"
            if first.value < 0.0
                return error("NEGATIVE ROOT")
            for exponent := first.dimension[]
                if exponent % 2 != 0
                    return error("ODD DIMENSION " + dimension_text(first.dimension))
            parts := ratio_parts(first.value)
            numerator := integer_sqrt(parts.numerator)
            denominator := integer_sqrt(parts.denominator)
            if numerator * numerator != parts.numerator or denominator * denominator != parts.denominator
                return error("NOT EXACT")
            return Quantity(real(numerator) / real(denominator), first.dimension / 2)
        second := try evaluate_quantity(database, nodes, item.arguments[1])
        try match_dimensions(first.dimension, second.dimension)
        take_first := if item.text == "min" then first.value <= second.value else first.value >= second.value
        return if take_first then first else second
    left := try evaluate_quantity(database, nodes, item.left)
    if item.kind == Operation.Negative
        return Quantity(-left.value, left.dimension)
    if item.kind == Operation.Power
        exponent := try checked_exponent(item.text)
        if left.value == 0.0 and exponent < 0
            return error("DIVISION BY ZERO")
        return Quantity(scalar_power(left.value, exponent), left.dimension * exponent)
    right := try evaluate_quantity(database, nodes, item.right)
    if item.kind == Operation.Add or item.kind == Operation.Subtract
        try match_dimensions(left.dimension, right.dimension)
        value := if item.kind == Operation.Add then left.value + right.value else left.value - right.value
        return Quantity(value, left.dimension)
    if item.kind == Operation.Multiply
        return Quantity(left.value * right.value, left.dimension + right.dimension)
    if right.value == 0.0
        return error("DIVISION BY ZERO")
    return Quantity(left.value / right.value, left.dimension - right.dimension)

Quantity | error quantity_value(const Database database, string source)
    parser := tokenize(source, true)
    root := try quantity_expression(&parser)
    if current(parser).kind != TokenKind.End
        return error(syntax_message(parser))
    return evaluate_quantity(database, parser.nodes, root)

void | error execute(Database &database, string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    command := words[0]
    if command == "DEFINE"
        name := words[1]
        try check_name(name, false)
        value := try parse_number(words[3])
        unit := try unit_quantity(database, words[4])
        match kind_dimension(database, name)
            int[] dimension
                return error("NAME TAKEN " + name)
            none
                match resolve(database, name)
                    Quantity found
                        return error("NAME TAKEN " + name)
                    none
                        if value <= 0.0
                            return error("NOT POSITIVE " + words[3])
        factor := value * unit.value
        database.units = database.units.append(Unit(name, Quantity(factor, unit.dimension), false, Definition(value, words[4])))
        emit("DEFINE {name} factor=" + fraction_text(factor) + " dim=" + dimension_text(unit.dimension) + " kind=" + kind_name(database, unit.dimension))
    elif command == "UNDEF"
        name := words[1]
        found := -1
        for index := database.units.indices()[]
            if database.units[index].symbol == name
                found = int(index)
                break
        if 0 <= found < 42
            return error("BUILTIN UNIT " + name)
        if found < 0
            return error("NOT DEFINED " + name)
        database.units = database.units[0:<found].concat(database.units[found + 1:])
        emit("UNDEF " + name)
    elif command == "DEFS"
        emit("DEFS count={int(#database.units) - 42}")
        for item := database.units[42:][]
            match item.definition
                Definition definition
                    emit("DEF {item.symbol} = " + fraction_text(definition.value) + " " + definition.expression + " factor=" + fraction_text(item.quantity.value) + " dim=" + dimension_text(item.quantity.dimension))
                none
                    continue
    elif command == "CONVERT" or command == "INVERT"
        value := try parse_number(words[1])
        source := try unit_quantity(database, words[2])
        target := try unit_quantity(database, words[4])
        if command == "INVERT"
            if dimensionless(source.dimension) or not dimensionless(source.dimension + target.dimension)
                return error("NOT RECIPROCAL " + dimension_text(source.dimension) + " vs " + dimension_text(target.dimension))
            if value == 0.0
                return error("DIVISION BY ZERO")
        else
            try match_dimensions(source.dimension, target.dimension)
        result := value * source.value
        if command == "INVERT"
            result = 1.0 / result
        result /= target.value
        emit(command + " " + fraction_text(value) + " " + words[2] + " = " + notation(result, words[4]))
    elif includes(["DIM", "REDUCE", "SIMPLIFY"], command)
        tree := try parse_unit(database, words[1])
        unit := evaluate_unit(tree.nodes, tree.root)
        if command == "DIM"
            emit("DIM {words[1]} = " + dimension_text(unit.dimension) + " factor=" + fraction_text(unit.value) + " kind=" + kind_name(database, unit.dimension))
        elif command == "REDUCE"
            emit("REDUCE {words[1]} = " + reduced_text(tree))
        else
            emit("SIMPLIFY {words[1]} = " + notation(unit.value, simplified(database, unit.dimension)))
    elif includes(["ADD", "SUB", "MUL", "DIV", "COMPARE"], command)
        first_value := try parse_number(words[1])
        first := try unit_quantity(database, words[2])
        second_value := try parse_number(words[3])
        second := try unit_quantity(database, words[4])
        has_target := #words == 7
        target := first
        if has_target
            target = try unit_quantity(database, words[6])
        prefix := command + " " + fraction_text(first_value) + " " + words[2] + " "
        suffix := " " + fraction_text(second_value) + " " + words[4]
        if command == "ADD" or command == "SUB" or command == "COMPARE"
            try match_dimensions(first.dimension, second.dimension)
            if has_target
                try match_dimensions(first.dimension, target.dimension)
            left := first_value * first.value
            right := second_value * second.value
            if command == "COMPARE"
                relation := if left < right then "<" elif left > right then ">" else "="
                ratio := if right == 0.0 then "undefined" else fraction_text(left / right)
                emit(prefix + relation + suffix + " ratio=" + ratio)
            else
                operation := if command == "ADD" then "+" else "-"
                result := if command == "ADD" then left + right else left - right
                result /= target.value
                emit(prefix + operation + suffix + " = " + notation(result, if has_target then words[6] else words[2]))
        else
            multiply := command == "MUL"
            dimension := first.dimension + second.dimension * (if multiply then 1 else -1)
            if not multiply and second_value == 0.0
                return error("DIVISION BY ZERO")
            if has_target
                try match_dimensions(dimension, target.dimension)
            raw := if multiply then first_value * second_value else first_value / second_value
            left := first_value * first.value
            right := second_value * second.value
            coherent := if multiply then left * right else left / right
            operation := if multiply then "*" else "/"
            text := prefix + operation + suffix + " = "
            if has_target
                text += notation(coherent / target.value, words[6])
            else
                right_unit := words[4]
                if not multiply and (right_unit.contains("*") or right_unit.contains("/"))
                    right_unit = "(" + right_unit + ")"
                text += fraction_text(raw) + " " + words[2] + operation + right_unit + " = " + notation(coherent, simplified(database, dimension))
            emit(text)
    elif command == "TEMP"
        value := try parse_number(words[1])
        for scale := [words[2], words[4]][]
            if not includes(["C", "F", "K", "R"], scale)
                return error("UNKNOWN SCALE " + scale)
        kelvin := value
        if words[2] == "C"
            kelvin = value + 5463.0 / 20.0
        elif words[2] == "F"
            kelvin = (value + 45967.0 / 100.0) * (5.0 / 9.0)
        elif words[2] == "R"
            kelvin = value * (5.0 / 9.0)
        if kelvin < 0.0
            return error("BELOW ABSOLUTE ZERO")
        result := kelvin
        if words[4] == "C"
            result = kelvin - 5463.0 / 20.0
        elif words[4] == "F"
            result = kelvin * (9.0 / 5.0) - 45967.0 / 100.0
        elif words[4] == "R"
            result = kelvin * (9.0 / 5.0)
        emit("TEMP " + fraction_text(value) + " " + words[2] + " = " + notation(result, words[4]))
    elif command == "LIST" or command == "TABLE"
        value := 1.0
        unit := Quantity()
        dimension := unit.dimension
        if command == "TABLE"
            value = try parse_number(words[1])
            unit = try unit_quantity(database, words[2])
            dimension = unit.dimension
        else
            match kind_dimension(database, words[1])
                int[] known
                    dimension = known
                none
                    unit = try unit_quantity(database, words[1])
                    dimension = unit.dimension
        selected := selected_units(database, dimension)
        if command == "TABLE"
            emit("TABLE " + fraction_text(value) + " " + words[2] + " dim=" + dimension_text(dimension) + " count={#selected}")
        else
            emit("LIST {words[1]} dim=" + dimension_text(dimension) + " kind=" + kind_name(database, dimension) + " count={#selected}")
        for item := selected[]
            if command == "TABLE"
                emit("ROW " + notation((value * unit.value) / item.quantity.value, item.symbol))
            else
                origin := "builtin"
                match item.definition
                    Definition definition
                        origin = "user"
                    none
                        origin = "builtin"
                prefix := if item.prefixable then "yes" else "no"
                emit("UNIT {item.symbol} factor=" + fraction_text(item.quantity.value) + " origin={origin} prefix={prefix}")
    elif command == "AUTO"
        value := try parse_number(words[1])
        unit := try unit_quantity(database, words[2])
        reference := -1
        for: 0 <= index < 42
            if database.units[index].prefixable and database.units[index].quantity.dimension == unit.dimension
                reference = index
                break
        if reference < 0
            return error("NO PREFIXABLE UNIT " + dimension_text(unit.dimension))
        chosen := database.units[reference]
        scaled := (value * unit.value) / chosen.quantity.value
        magnitude := math.abs(scaled)
        exponent := 0
        if magnitude >= 1.0
            while exponent < 9 and magnitude >= scalar_power(10.0, exponent + 3)
                exponent += 3
        elif magnitude > 0.0
            while exponent > -9 and magnitude < scalar_power(10.0, exponent)
                exponent -= 3
        prefixes := ["n", "u", "m", "", "k", "M", "G"]
        label := prefixes[(exponent + 9) / 3] + chosen.symbol
        emit("AUTO " + fraction_text(value) + " " + words[2] + " = " + notation(scaled / scalar_power(10.0, exponent), label))
    elif command == "SPLIT"
        value := try parse_number(words[1])
        unit := try unit_quantity(database, words[2])
        parts := words[4].split(",")
        Quantity[] targets := []
        for part := parts[]
            parsed := try unit_quantity(database, part)
            targets = targets.append(parsed)
        if value < 0.0
            return error("NEGATIVE VALUE")
        for target := targets[]
            try match_dimensions(unit.dimension, target.dimension)
        for: 1 <= index < int(#targets)
            if targets[index - 1].value <= targets[index].value
                return error("UNIT ORDER")
        remaining := value * unit.value
        string[] pieces := []
        for: 0 <= index < int(#parts) - 1
            quotient := ratio_parts(remaining / targets[index].value)
            count := quotient.numerator / quotient.denominator
            remaining -= real(count) * targets[index].value
            pieces = pieces.append("{count} {parts[index]}")
        last := int(#parts) - 1
        pieces = pieces.append(notation(remaining / targets[last].value, parts[last]))
        emit("SPLIT " + fraction_text(value) + " " + words[2] + " = " + pieces.join(" "))
    elif command == "LET"
        try check_name(words[1], true)
        quantity := try quantity_value(database, words[3])
        .database.variables.set(words[1], quantity)
        emit("LET {words[1]} = " + notation(quantity.value, simplified(database, quantity.dimension)))
    elif command == "EVAL"
        quantity := try quantity_value(database, words[1])
        value := quantity.value
        label := simplified(database, quantity.dimension)
        if #words == 4
            unit := try unit_quantity(database, words[3])
            try match_dimensions(quantity.dimension, unit.dimension)
            value /= unit.value
            label = words[3]
        emit("EVAL {words[1]} = " + notation(value, label))
    elif command == "VARS"
        names := database.variables.keys().sorted()
        emit("VARS count={#names}")
        for name := names[]
            match database.variables.get(name)
                Quantity quantity
                    emit("VAR {name} = " + notation(quantity.value, simplified(database, quantity.dimension)))
                none
                    continue
    else
        return error("UNKNOWN COMMAND " + command)
    return void

converter := new_database()
int command_count
scan(&command_count)
for: 0 <= command_index < command_count
    string command_line
    scan(&command_line)
    match execute(&converter, command_line)
        void
            continue
        error problem
            emit("ERROR " + problem.message)
